name: Megahard-Whiteboard
description: A free, open-source whiteboard that keeps your boards on your own device. No accounts, no cloud, works offline.

paragraphs: A free, open-source whiteboard that keeps your boards on your own device. There are no accounts and no tracking, it works offline, and you can share a board to draw on it live with others.
Use Megahard Whiteboard in your browser → · Website

It runs in your browser, and nothing you draw is uploaded unless you share a board. To use it like a desktop app, choose Install in your browser's address bar (Chrome and Edge) and it gets its own window, a Start menu entry and offline support.
features: A bottom dock with an ink tray that pops up while drawing: three pens. Click a pen again for thickness and opacity sliders, two rows of colors plus a custom color picker, and line ends. Pressure-sensitive with a stylus,…
Pens can draw arrows at the end or at both ends.
Highlighter with its own thickness, opacity and color.
Hold Shift while drawing for a perfectly straight line (snaps to horizontal, vertical and 45°).
Eraser that removes whole strokes. The eraser end of a stylus also works.

whatItDoes.text: A free, open-source whiteboard that keeps your boards on your own device. There are no accounts and no tracking, it works offline, and you can share a board to draw on it live with others.

requirements.text: There are no accounts and no tracking, it works offline, and you can share a board to draw on it live with others.
People joining need no account: they enter a name (or take a suggested one, like "Blue Otter").
